observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Stage of a large auditorium with a live folk orchestra in the background and an audience watching from below.
observation.dancers: A large group of male dancers, plus one soloist lifted or dancing separately.
observation.formation_and_space: Initially a single straight line across the stage, breaking into circles and travelling across the stage floor.
observation.posture: Upright torso with occasional bending during crouching or high kicks, weight shifting rapidly between feet.
observation.footwork: Energetic stamping, high knee raises, leaping, and intricate stepping patterns synchronized with the beat; exact heel-toe weight transfers cannot be definitively discerned from video compression.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out to the sides, raised overhead, or holding wooden sticks decorated with colorful ribbons.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively stable and upright, moving vertically during jumps and squats without isolated hip shimmies.
observation.partnering: None; dancers perform in formation without physical contact between partners.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent high leaps, vertical jumps, deep knee squats down to the floor, and turns.
observation.costume_and_props: White folk shirts and trousers, embroidered vests, hats with ribbons, and held wooden sticks/batons.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot-to-floor contact and precise weight distribution details are obscured by video resolution and rapid movement speed.

signature_moments.what: One dancer standing upright on the shoulders of two other dancers while holding a stick in the air.
Dancers executing deep knee squats while moving rapidly across the stage in line.
Dancers performing high knee lifts and stamping vigorously while traveling in a circle.
Dancers dropping simultaneously into low single-knee lunges on the floor.
